info.title: Demand per law office, by state: residents, bankruptcy cases, fatal crashes, divorces, Spanish speakers and evictions for each law office: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Demand per law office, by state: residents, bankruptcy cases, fatal crashes, divorces, Spanish speakers and evictions for each law office: Where there is the most legal demand for each law office. Five public datasets joined by state: private law-office establishments (2026 Q1, 177,138 in the 51 states) against residents, bankruptcy cases commenced (12 months ending 2026-09-30), fatal crashes (2024), divorces in the last 12 months and Spanish speakers with limited English (ACS 2020-2024), and eviction filings for the 23 states with recent eviction data. Each state is placed in the highest, middle or lowest third on every ratio and overall.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
